Name: E2E Drift Chat

Summary:
User Story:
GWA-22817
Product:
Office
Brand:
RC US/CA
Account type(/s):
Admin

Preconditions:
Entry points:
For Office 8.2:
Create account via MVP 8.0 signup - [domain] + parameters from
List of funnels with entry points US
For AIR:
Create account via AIR signup
[domain] + parameters from
List of funnels with entry points US
Note:
Case can be passed only on OPS-Stage or Production environments

Steps:
Step: Open activation link
Expected: Email verification is displayed
The Drift chat icon appears after 2 sec in the right corner of the page

Step: Click on
Drift chat icon
Expected: Drift chat is shown expanded
Initial bot message "Hello, How can I help you today?" is triggered

Step: Click on "X"
icon
Expected: Drift chat is collapsed
The chat icon will stay on the lower right page

Step: Pass Email verification
Open Drift chat
Expected: Drift chat is opened

Step: Through the entire flow to the end
Expected: Chat is displayed on the all pages

Preconditions:
Entry points:
Create a new unconfirmed account
Open activation link
Go to the Company address page
Notes:
Fill all fields with valid values, except current
To check all strings change the language to en_us if possible

Steps:
Step: Observe the page
Expected: Text - Business Information Verification
Text - Company address
Field
s:
Company registered number
Official company name
Trading name(DBA)
Button - Add more Trading names
Field
s:
Official company address (Listed in the Company House Register) - link with value
https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/
Road/Street
City
Post code
County
Country - United Kingdom (disabled)
Button - Save and continue (disabled)

Step: Check fields validation:
Check "Company registered number" with more than 64 symbols
Check "Official company name" with more than 64 symbols
Check "Trading name (DBA)" with more than 64 symbols
Check "Official company address (Listed in the Company House Register)" with more than 64 symbols
Expected: Data is not acceptable

Step: Check trading name functionality
Add plus one trading name
Click button Remove
Expected: The new field has been added with the label  "Trading name", and also appears button "Remove"
Field is deleted

Step: Add 100 trading names
Expected: Button  "Add more Trading names" is disapeared

Step: Fill all fields with valid data and clcik b
utton "Save and continue" is enabled
Expected: Redirect to company details page

Name: BDD: Phone Verification page

Summary:
User Story:
GWA-6628
,
GWA-21686
Tier(/s):
Office/Phoenix/Fax
Brand:
UK/EU/US/CA/AU/Charter
Account type(/s):
Admin

Preconditions:
Entry point(/s):
Pass signup and get activation e-mail.
Set cookie gw_autotest_skip_smb = 1 before opening activation link
Remember "Contact number" which was used as Contact Number on Signup
To emulate the situation when phone verification is needed set cookie confirm_result - NotConfirmed_RequiresPhoneVerification on
domain/web/setup/qa.html
page (Use the correct domain for your environment)
Note:
For brands which possible to change language use en_us locale to check strings in this case.

Steps:
Step: Open activation link in the same browser wher you set cookie
Expected: You are redirected to phone verification page

Step: Observe page
Expected: Logo is displayed related to brand.
Title: "Mobile Number Verification".
Text: "Use for authentication of your mobile phone number"
Text: "By clicking Next, you will be receiving a phone call in a few seconds that will provide you with a verification code that you must enter in the following screen."

Step: Check the appearing of saved "Contact number" in "Mobile Number" field
Expected: The number should be the same as "Contact number"

Step: Leave "Mobile Number" input field empty and click "Next" button
Expected: Placeholder "(000) 000-0000" and the "Next" button became disabled

Step: Enter correct number and click "Next" button. Check the block
Expected: "Verification code" field appears
"Mobile Number field becomes not editable
"Edit" button appears
"Did not receive the call? Try again!" link appears

Step: Click on "Did not receive the call? Try again!"
Expected: Text: "Your verification code has been resent to your contact phone number." appears

Step: Click on the "Edit" button.
Expected: "Verification code" field disappeared
"Mobile Number" field becomes editable
"Edit" button disappeared

Step: Enter the wrong number and click "Next"
Expected: An error message "
The contact phone number you entered appears to be invalid, please check the number and try again
" appears above the field.

Step: Enter correct phone number and
incorrect verification code and press "Next"
Expected: An error message "
Verification code is not valid
" appear

Step: Input correct verification code -> click "Next"
Expected: Mobile Number verification passed.
